_comment: Values the filled NDA must contain, and the strings it must NOT contain.
These live here, not in scripts/, on purpose: docs/selling/ is in DROP_DIRS of
scripts/build-license-bundle.cjs, so this file never reaches the DataVendor
bundle. A cédula hard-coded in a script under scripts/ would have shipped.
The verifier fails loudly if this file is absent rather than passing vacuously.
